title: Marshlands of Mesopotamia (Ahwar)
full_text:
Early morning, we will drive to Chibayesh and have a marshland experience.
Local breakfast in the reed house with a local family.
Followed by a sightseeing tour in numerous floating villages - the Gardens of Eden (birds, fishes, buffalos, reed, plants, and meeting the people of Ahwar). It is one of the largest ecosystems in the world and a UNESCO world heritage site.
After the tour, the lunch will be a meal of a special kind of fish in Iraq which lives only in the marshlands. The lunch will take place in the reed house - Al Mudhif.
Stories from local people "Al Madan" who have adapted to life on the water over the centuries.
After lunch, drive back to Baghdad.
